summary: gRINN (get Residue Interaction eNergies and Networks) is standalone software for pairwise residue interaction-energy analysis of protein MD trajectories and protein energy networks. It extracts force-field-based nonbonded interaction energies (electrostatic, van der Waals, total) between residue pairs using external MD engines like NAMD, CHARMM, and GROMACS. gRINN produces time series of interaction energies E_ij(t), averages, and constructs Interaction Energy Matrices (IEM). It calculates equal-time linear correlations between interaction-energy series, projecting these to residue-correlation measures. Protein Energy Networks (PENs) are built with residues as nodes and weighted edges from energetic relations.
